newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end firmer,track Chicago's gain.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end firmer,track Chicago's gain.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo corn futures ended mostly firmer on Tuesday, following gains in the Chicago market on Monday, traders said.
Prices ranged from 10 yen per tonne lower to 330 yen firmer. Benchmark September was up 120 yen to 15,000 yen. Daily volume was 59,941 lots.

The market started the day on firmer tone amid caution that the market was oversold, but buying momentum ebbed later amid a dearth of fresh incentives. "Trade lacked clear direction. Prices are unlikely to move wildly until the USDA's report is released later this week," one trader said.
